sections.title: Security operations
sections.subtitle: Detect, triage and contain with a clear operational response.

sections.heading: Turn security signals into informed action
sections.body:
Monitoring matters when teams know what to do with the findings. Linkfields connects security operations — Splunk SIEM and Qualys monitoring — with incident response using Rapid7: detect, triage, contain.

Align the information your tools provide with operational responsibilities and escalation paths. Help security and technology teams investigate the right issues, coordinate containment and carry lessons back into day-to-day operations.

sections.heading: Monitoring and response, working together
sections.description: Security operations: Splunk SIEM, Qualys monitoring. Incident response: Rapid7: detect, triage, contain.

cards.title: Splunk SIEM
cards.description: Bring security events into the operational picture. Support investigation with the context teams need to assess suspicious activity.

cards.title: Qualys monitoring
cards.description: Use monitoring findings to inform security priorities. Connect the issues identified with responsible owners and follow-up actions.

cards.title: Incident response
cards.description: Rapid7: detect, triage, contain. Coordinate investigation and containment within agreed responsibilities and escalation procedures.

cards.title: Operational review
cards.description: Review what incidents and investigations reveal. Refine monitoring priorities, response procedures and the handover between teams.

sections.title: Make the next security signal actionable
sections.description: Connect visibility with a response your teams understand.

sections.heading: A coordinated path from detection to containment
sections.description: Establish the scope of monitoring and response with your teams. Agree what is observed, how it is assessed and who makes each decision.

items.title: Establish visibility
items.description: Understand the systems in scope, the security information available and the responsibilities around Splunk SIEM and Qualys monitoring.

items.title: Detect and triage
items.description: Review signals in context, investigate relevant activity and agree the priority of findings before escalating a response.

items.title: Coordinate containment
items.description: Use agreed response procedures and Rapid7 to support containment. Keep system owners and relevant stakeholders involved in decisions.

items.title: Review and improve
items.description: Document the response, review contributing conditions and agree follow-up actions. Feed the learning into monitoring and response procedures.
